collectr_world: Karel "Ash" World arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a letter he never sent and a borrowed coat two sizes too big. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Karel "Ash" World let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Karel "Ash" World found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: an old man with a dog, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
A man asked Karel "Ash" World to describe Old Harrow without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Karel "Ash" World keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a letter he never sent. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom.
jacksondeehring: Isidor Jacksondeehr arrived on Day 5 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Isidor Jacksondeehr tipped water from a boot and a small beetle climbed out. At least one passenger had enjoyed the crossing.
scottjseale: Gustav Scottjseale took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Gustav Scottjseale added a leak above the man's head in pencil. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Scottjseale. Gustav Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Quentin Arvidgrubb and Gustav Scottjseale sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Scottjseale. Gustav Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
